messages:
ava: heads up — last hour we've seen ~0.3% handshake failures in eu-west on prod behind proxy-alpha. Symptoms look like mTLS resumption errors after keystore prune. logs point at SNI/session-affinity TTL mismatch. Anyone own the rotator/RBAC that prunes keys?
oncall-bot: Prometheus alert: TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAIL_RATE > 0.2% for proxy-alpha-eu-west (P2) — incident created: #INC-2026-124
sam: I'm starting a quick sleuth. @mike can you pull keystore list from proxy-alpha and check last_modified times? suspect TTLs from session affinity (nginx) vs rotator TTL.
mike: grabbing now. saw keystore prune job ran ~10:12 UTC. rotator logs show `prune_orphaned` with cutoff=2026-03-21T10:10:00Z removed=12. But session tickets have TTL 3600s set by proxy config — mismatch when rotator uses 1h earlier cutoff due to clock skew? attaching logs shortly.
natalie: also check KMS unwrap errors in the same window. If RBAC prevented decrypt, rotator may have dropped keys flagged as orphaned.
ava: here's a grep of the rotator log and proxy error snippet:
```
rotator[pid=22] INFO prune_keys cutoff=2026-03-21T10:10:00Z removed=12
proxy-alpha ERROR tls: handshake failed: session ticket not found (sni=app1.redwood.internal)
kms: decrypt error: AccessDenied for key alias/rotator-key (200 ok -> 403)
```
sam: that KMS AccessDenied smells like RBAC scope tightening on the rotator's role. Kevin pushed a policy change last deploy? @kevin any recent IAM changes?
kevin: yep I applied a narrower KMS policy in the eu account yesterday to limit `kms:Decrypt` to a specific keystore prefix. probably too restrictive. rolling back now. pushing PR to restore `kms:Decrypt` for rotator principal. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/482
natalie: audit logs show rotator principal attempting Decrypt and receiving `kms:AccessDenied` starting 10:09:58 UTC. cloudtrail shows Principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/rotator-eu.
sam: operational plan — 1) roll back IAM change (kevin) 2) re-run rotator dry-run + restore keys (mike) 3) bump session ticket TTL to 2h temporarily (proxy team) 4) monitor TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAIL_RATE and alert.
mike: re-run done, restored 12 keys; rotator able to unwrap keys after policy rollback. proxy TTL change scheduled in 5m. verifying resumption now.
oncall-bot: Alert cleared: TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAIL_RATE back to baseline (0.04%) — auto-note appended.
ava: follow-ups: 1) add a preflight KMS unwrap check to rotator job 2) ensure rotator clock sync with NTP and include jitter tolerance in prune cutoff 3) add audit log watch for `kms:AccessDenied` spikes to paging rules 4) document session ticket TTL alignment in runbook.
sam: I'll open follow-up tickets and assign owners. TL;DR: RBAC tightening caused KMS unwrap to fail -> rotator pruned keys earlier than proxies expected -> mTLS resumption errors. Good catch. :thumbsup:
